does: Gives a map from text key to condition for one kind of a spell prototype's conditions (RCX the prototype, RDX the map written, R8 the condition kind): the default text key first, then each further key.

evidence.says: calls eoc::SpellPrototype::GetSpellConditions with the key from 0x1050590 and inserts each result into a FixedString-keyed map; fits GetRollSpellConditionsPerTextKey(ESpellConditionsType) of the builds with symbols
in a goblin's turn its calls of GetSpellConditions at +0x104CB54 (type 1) return the conditions the AI scorers then look up and pass to the chance
